misses.description: J1 (controller), J2 (platform engineer), J3 (legal operations): README.md:224-228 and PILOT.md:15 leave the publisher, price and support terms as unfilled placeholders ([ENTITY], [PRICE], [SUPPORT-TERMS]); the only liability term is the licence's "as is"

J1 (controller), J2 (platform engineer), J3 (legal operations): REPLAYERS.md:4 and the front page give the contact for kills, questions and security reports as a literal [ADDRESS] placeholder, so a break cannot be reported anywhere
misses.fixed_by: 2026-10-05 / a contact address for kills, questions and security reports, and a SECURITY.md that says what happens to a report

misses.description: J1 (controller): `ap` on a bill with no payment history printed APPROVE, payable: true and exit 0 with the duplicate check not run, while the library gate returned REVIEW for the same bill; docs/GLOSSARY.md:13 says the AP gate never pays on PASS-WITH-OPEN
misses.fixed_by: 2026-10-05 / ap fails closed: a bill with a check that could not run reads A PERSON DECIDES, payable false, exit 2

misses.description: J1 (controller): `ap --gate` was accepted silently and changed nothing, and `ap --help` did not list it
misses.fixed_by: 2026-10-05 / ap --help lists --gate as the default reading, which fails closed; --allow-open is the one opt-out

misses.description: J2 (platform engineer): README.md:13-15 and the CLI defaults: a PASS-WITH-OPEN verdict exited 0 unless --gate was given, so a CI user wiring exit codes got fail-open by default
misses.fixed_by: 2026-10-05 / the commands exit 2 on PASS-WITH-OPEN by default; --allow-open is the opt-out

misses.description: J2 (platform engineer): the tolerance identity spread roundingCap.perLine with [...x], so the string "TAX_INT" and its seven-character array hashed alike while the engine's .includes() read them differently: one verdict_id for a PASS and a FAIL, reachable through the library and HTTP /v1/verify
misses.fixed_by: 2026-10-05 / a tolerance override is checked for one strict shape wherever a verdict is issued; a string rule list is refused

misses.description: J2 (platform engineer): the non-finite refusal covered CLI file reads and declarative rules only: built-in verify() gave one hash for null, Infinity, -Infinity and NaN, with PASS for null and FAIL for the rest, and the HTTP and MCP servers parsed bodies with plain JSON.parse
misses.fixed_by: 2026-10-05 / verify() and the HTTP and MCP servers refuse non-finite numbers before hashing, as the command line does

misses.description: J2 (platform engineer): duplicate JSON keys were accepted everywhere, including inside a signed envelope: an "outcome":"FAIL" inserted before the real "outcome":"PASS" verified under --trusted-key --strict
misses.fixed_by: 2026-10-05 / a key repeated in one JSON object is refused at every reader, signed envelopes included

misses.description: J2 (platform engineer): REPLAY.md:70-71 said three kinds of input are refused before any engine sees them, and the hash-input source comment said two inputs that differ never share a hash; the library, HTTP and MCP paths broke both (the tolerance, non-finite and duplicate-key rows of this table)
misses.fixed_by: 2026-10-05 / REPLAY.md states the refusals at every entry point, and the library, HTTP and MCP paths now hold them

misses.description: J3 (legal operations): binding was satisfied by any opinion text that cites the case: a Cooper v. Aaron text passed for Brown and for Marbury under the default strict binding, against LEGAL.md:10-12
misses.fixed_by: 2026-10-05 / a text binds to a cite only through its caption; a text that cites the case only in its body abstains

misses.description: J3 (legal operations): a parties-only binding gave outcome PASS, gate status PASS and exit 0 even when the JSON marked the choice load_bearing: true (LEGAL.md:76-81)
misses.fixed_by: 2026-10-05 / a quotation bound by parties only is not certified: the verdict is not PASS and the command exits 2

misses.description: J3 (legal operations): a trailing ellipsis that drops a condition passed ("except where ..."; "provided the waiver is made voluntarily ..."), reported as an ellipsis at the edge of the quotation, not located
misses.fixed_by: 2026-10-05 / an ellipsis at the end of a quotation that leaves out a condition abstains as an elided condition

misses.fixed_by: 2026-10-05 / an ellipsis that leaves out a clause opened by "after" abstains as an elided condition

misses.description: J3 (legal operations): LEGAL.md:26 said an ellipsis over a condition abstains, and MISSES.md:19 marks the condition-dropping ellipsis row fixed by legal@0.2.0, while edge ellipses and a bracketed capital that drop a condition still passed
